suggestions.assertion: The verdict is not 'ready to merge' (objective: report_not_ready_to_merge)
suggestions.reason: This and the other three objective checks (report_mentions_scratch, report_mentions_format_unstaged, report_mentions_threshold_gap) read as substring/phrase matches against the report text. A hedging report that reflexively concludes 'not ready to merge' with no real analysis, or one that name-drops 'src/scratch.ts', 'src/format.ts', or '2000' in passing without substantive findings, would also satisfy these checks. This run's mentions are all substantive (verified above), but the checks themselves don't distinguish that from keyword-stuffing.

The spec has two independent, equally real gaps: FLAT5's missing >=2000-cent gate (AC2/AC3, covered by report_mentions_threshold_gap) and the missing case-insensitivity handling (AC5, verified above but not covered by any expectation). A run that found only the FLAT5 gap and missed AC5 entirely would still score 6/6 — worth adding a dedicated expectation for the case-insensitivity gap.

eval_feedback.overall: Evals are largely solid and this run genuinely earns all 6 passes on substance, independently re-verified against the actual workspace source (src/pricing.ts, docs/spec-coupons.md, src/orders.ts) rather than taking the report's claims at face value. The four report_mentions_* / report_not_ready_to_merge checks are phrase-matches rather than substance checks, and the AC5 case-insensitivity gap has no dedicated coverage — see suggestions.
